_note: Baselines are byte counts from a real `bun run build` plus `cargo build --release -p essay-cli -p essay-desktop` -- the same commands the `size` job runs. The check fails when a build exceeds baseline * (1 + tolerancePercent / 100); set an entry back to null to make it informational again.
_provenance: Measured locally on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, the same target the `size` job uses (runs-on: windows-latest). Fat LTO output is sensitive to the compiler version, so if the FIRST CI run after these landed misses by a few percent, take CI's numbers from the job summary rather than assuming a regression -- that is a toolchain difference, not code growth. A miss on any run after that is a real one.
_binaryNameNote: essay-cli's [[bin]] is named `essay`, not `essay-cli` (see crates/essay-cli/Cargo.toml) -- `cargo build -p essay-cli` produces target/release/essay.exe. essay-desktop has no [[bin]] override, so its binary matches the package name: target/release/essay-desktop.exe.
